content: Jesus kabadani Moisés kabadani-ra aradaki

Oigamina, Jesus kaija'ari hari. Deus a'onira kaboa'i'iki a'oni jaboni kidiania nama aokhana. Vakava'ibodivaranijahaki ada Jesus. Deua bikarona'iki ada, sasidotxi vakadika'da'di hira kaimoni, Deu-ra kanikhariaki ada akadimoni, haria kakodiavini hiki jaboni ida Deus monina-ra akajari'daravini-ra akahivini.

Deua bihonaria'aha ada Jesus va'ora akadava'ara kaimoni adani kidija'ari. Bada bini'amanihi afohahavi, ni-bikajonipa'itxiki ida Deus athi. Moisés kohana jaboni bada bini'ahahavi'iki ida badani Deua bihonariavini hi'iki, va'ora akadava'a'iki adani Deus kaija'ari.

Hari. Ija'aria vanakaidivaki ida gora, vanakaidivavini arafiaki ada gora namonahava abono. Gora namonahava abono fori hiki ada Jesus. Gora fori hiki ada Moisés. Jesus kabadani jahani arafiani-ra akahiva. Jesus kabadani Moisés kabadani-ra aradaki.
Gora-ra anokihi; aogahi ida ija'ari gora-ra namonahaki hojani. Deus vania binamonahabiininija ida hahavi hojaki.

Moiséa bada bini'ahaha'oadahaki ida Deua binofiki. Deus kahonai abono ada. Kidika'da'di gorana bodinia bada niki fori hiki ada. Moisés va'ora vara ni'ajora'iki adani ija'ari Deua bivava'isohihijoraki kavaranihia.

Hari. Cristoa jaboni bada bini'ahaha'oadahaki ida Deua binofiki, va'ora akadava'aki adani Deus kaija'ari. Deus kaisai ada Cristo. Kidiabi'i gorana bodinia bada niki ada. Harivani Deus gorana hari. Deu-ra akava'ipahiniravini vani avakaijokaha'oadahaha; haria kaibavijahahivini hiki-ra anaviahanokhahi jaboni; Deus gorana kaija'arini arihihi.
Deua binaibavijahaki ida akoiri ibavini
Hari. Mitha vani'a bana hida Ma'onahai Jahaki athi Deus athi kapapirania hojaki:

content.text: “Hidakaba'i mitha vani'a bana hida Deus a'onira ni'avini hiki.
Amasia vaadahana kari ni-Deus vakadiania hojaki-ra vavakaijoka'iki.

content: Hari. Niha ada Deus:

content.text: 40 badara ipohini vani vada vani'abakhiaja ida kodibadani danoki bada
Oniani ida vakadiva'ibodivarani hora naihamahivini hija.
Vanaabarihi afobakhia ida va'ora ohonariavini hiki.

content: Niha ada Deus.
Oigamina, avaabononi avakava'igairi afohanana bana. Jahari'oamanija ida Deus athi kajonani. Hari'a avava'ini bodinia Deu-ra vakajari'da mahija Deus hokiki-ra avakava'ipahiniravini.

Ni-nikia akahojaina jahaki. Jahaki ida avaabononi avakakakodiakhamavini afobakhia Deu-ra avavakaijokavini. Hari'a bana hojai asohiriki makhanirini-ra vakahi mahija morobohariki fori avihiravini. Deus haria honariavini hiki ida hidakaba'i athi mitha ani'avini. Asia hojaki hida athi “hidakaba'i” anaabaja kaimoni.
Ariabinirina oadani Cristo-ra avakaijokavini-ra akava'ipahinirihi, Cristo-ra avakaijokabiininivini fori hini, oniani ida Cristo ipohina haria nihaja bana.
Deus athi kapapirania hojaki hida athii:

content.text: “Hidakaba'i mitha vani'a bana hida Deus a'onira ni'avini hiki.

content: Niki ida Deus athi.
Ija'ari hahavi Moisés va'ora banani'iki avikhaonani'ina Egito kaarabonia, vakamithabakhia'iki ida Deus athi. Kaba'i, vakajonibakhiaha ada Deus.
Hari. 40 badara ipohini Deus va'ora kaihamahiki adani ija'ari hojai Deua bivajaharikia vakahojaibakhia'iki, Deu-ra vavakaijokaravini, oniani ida va'ora nihimavini hija vahoarahanana amasia.

Deus vara va'ora vani'a'iki adani athi kajonini vihi'iki: —Deus ka'oa ohina mani ida va'ora onava'iponi'imariniravini hija bana. Jokoa avikhariha adani Canaã kaaraboni va'ora ono'avini hikia, avakoirira kaimoni kodiania — niha ada Deus.
Hari. Oniaroa. Aogaki ida namitha'iki vakadiania. Deu-ra vavakaijokaravini mani ida arabo Deus va'ora no'avini hikia avikhana-ra vakaabokaravini hija.
